description: District Cooling Plant Characteristics by Economic Activity is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents detailed operational characteristics of district cooling plants in Qatar, including installed cooling capacity, connected load, peak cooling load, plant utilization rate, and annual cooling energy production. Data is categorized by economic activity and helps assess plant efficiency and demand management. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are district, cooling, utilization, energy, efficiency. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
